question: Who among the following was awarded the TTK Memorial Award by Madras Music Academy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vempati Chinna Satyam.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

 
• ** Vempati Chinna Satyam was awarded the TTK Memorial Award by Madras Music Academy.**
 
• He was a renowned **Kuchipudi dancer and choreographer from Andhra Pradesh.**
 
• Mahaboob Subhani is a tabla player from Hyderabad who has won several awards for his contributions to Indian classical music.
 
• Uday Shankar was a pioneer of modern Indian dance and is known for fusing Indian classical dance with Western ballet.
 
• Pandit Birju Maharaj is a renowned Kathak dancer and choreographer from Lucknow who has been awarded several prestigious awards for his contributions to Indian classical dance.
